lines.en: label kirinspecial45p2:
scene nightsky
I decide to be a man of my word and tap on Kirin’s name in my phone since apparently the two of us go on dates now.
lines.zh: 我决定做个言出必行的人，点开了手机里 Kirin 的名字，毕竟我们俩现在显然开始约会了。

lines.en: I figure there’s a decent chance she’s either not going to answer or just bail on me once she does as organizing something like this is a lot different than just bumping into each other and running with it.
lines.zh: 我估摸着她很可能要么不接，要么接了也会放我鸽子，因为筹划这种事跟碰巧撞上然后顺其自然完全是两码事。

lines.en: I get that she likes me — that’s not a new development. And it was obvious she’d have to come to terms with that sooner or later, but that doesn’t mean any of this feels “normal.”
lines.zh: 我知道她喜欢我——这倒不算什么新进展。显然她迟早得接受这一点，但这并不意味着这一切感觉起来“正常”。

lines.en: What if it’s becoming too real for her?
lines.zh: 如果这对她来说变得太真实了呢？

lines.en: If she’s as much like me as she thinks she is, she might already be in the process of backing down.
lines.zh: 如果她真像她自己以为的那么像我，她说不定已经在打退堂鼓了。

lines.en: It’s taken me several iterations of the same exact school year to even {i}begin{/i} to accept the idea of change that isn’t directly tied to coital probability and...I just don’t know if she’s there yet.
lines.zh: 我经历了同一个学年的一次又一次循环，才勉强{i}开始{/i}接受那种不与性交概率直接挂钩的改变……而我只是不知道她到没到那一步。

lines.en: She might think she wants to run away, and she might think that {i}I’m{/i} enough for {i}her,{/i} but I know that’s just flat out untrue.
lines.zh: 她也许以为自己想逃，她也许以为{i}我{/i}对{i}她{/i}来说已经够了，但我知道那根本就是错的。

lines.en: But {i}how{/i} do I know it’s untrue, you ask?
lines.zh: 可你要问，我{i}怎么{/i}知道那是错的？

lines.en: That’s easy.
lines.zh: 很简单。

lines.en: It’s because I’m not enough for anyone.
lines.zh: 因为我对任何人都不够。

lines.en: How {i}can{/i} I be when there are still so many parts of me that are missing?
lines.zh: 当我身上还缺了那么多块的时候，我{i}怎么{/i}可能够？

lines.en: The phone stops ringing.
lines.zh: 电话停止了响铃。

lines.en: I had a feeling it would.
lines.zh: 我有预感会是这样。

lines.en: scene black
The night ends without me ever hearing from Kirin.
lines.zh: 那一夜结束了，Kirin 始终没有联系我。

lines.en: And the two of us move backward instead of forward.
lines.zh: 而我们两个不是向前，而是向后退。

lines.en: Right back to where we belong.
lines.zh: 一路退回了我们本该在的地方。

lines.en: But then {i}my{/i} phone begins to ring.
lines.zh: 但就在这时，{i}我的{/i}手机响了起来。

lines.en: scene nightsky
And the night begins again.
lines.zh: 而这一夜，重新开始了。

lines.en: : Hey! Sorry! I left my phone in the other room while I was doing my makeup. Are we still doing this?
lines.zh: : 嘿！抱歉！我化妆的时候把手机落在另一个房间了。我们还去吗？

lines.en: : You mean acknowledging the probability of a relationship between the two of us that exists without any immediate promise or expectation of sex?
lines.zh: : 你是指承认我们两个之间存在一种没有任何即时性爱承诺或预期的恋爱可能性？

lines.en: : Just say dating, it’s shorter. But yeah. Basically that.
lines.zh: : 就说“约会”吧，短一点。不过对，基本就是那个意思。

lines.en: : Then I guess so. That is why I’m calling, after all.
lines.zh: : 那我想是吧。毕竟我打电话就是为了这个。

lines.en: : I think I’m actually getting pretty good at this dating thing. You’re like the third or fourth girl in recent memory I’ve gone on an actual date with.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我其实已经挺擅长约会这回事了。你大概是我最近记忆里第三个还是第四个真正约会过的女生。

lines.en: : Wow, you know exactly what to say to get a woman excited, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇，你真懂得该说什么才能让一个女人兴奋，是吧？

lines.en: : You’re not a woman, you’re a girl.
lines.zh: : 你不是女人，你是女生。

lines.en: : Doesn’t that make you, like, five times creepier in this context? I’m trying to give you a hand here.
lines.zh: : 那在这语境下，你不是变得，那个……恶心五倍了吗？我这是在帮你呢。

lines.en: : Also, we’ll see if you’re still calling me a {i}girl{/i} after you get a look at me tonight. I am fucking {i}hot{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : 还有，等你今晚看到我的样子，看你还叫不叫我{i}女生{/i}。我现在他妈{i}超辣{/i}。

lines.en: : Great, that means you’ll attract all of the attention and people will stare at you instead of focusing on the age gap between us.
lines.zh: : 很好，那意味着你会吸引所有人的目光，大家只会盯着你看，而不会去注意我们之间的年龄差。

lines.en: : {i}I’m telling you{/i} that won’t be a thing tonight. Trust me. The last thing I want is somebody interrupting our date by asking if you’re my dad.
lines.zh: : {i}我跟你说了{/i}今晚不会有那种事的。相信我。我最不想的就是有人跑来问你是不是我爸，把我们的约会打断。

lines.en: : Inside the bedroom, that kind of thing is okay. Out at dinner? Not so much.
lines.zh: : 在卧室里，那种事倒无所谓。在外面吃晚餐？就另当别论了。

lines.en: : Is that what we’re doing? Dinner?
lines.zh: : 我们是要去吃饭？

lines.en: : Do you seriously not even know?
lines.zh: : 你该不会真的不知道吧？

lines.en: : ...Just kidding?
lines.zh: : ……开玩笑的啦？

lines.en: : We could always go dancing instead! I have plenty of experience grinding on you already, so we won’t even look out of place.
lines.zh: : 我们也可以去跳舞！我在你身上蹭的经验已经够多了，所以我们一点都不会显得格格不入。

lines.en: : Dinner it is. I’ll send you an address.
lines.zh: : 那就吃饭。我把地址发给你。

lines.en: : Okay, but pick a nice place. I want people to see me.
lines.zh: : 好，但要挑个高级点的地方。我想让别人看见我。

lines.en: : How nice?
lines.zh: : 多高级？

lines.en: : If there are prices listed on the menu, it’s probably too cheap.
lines.zh: : 如果菜单上标了价格，那大概就太便宜了。

lines.en: : But I only know one place like that and-
lines.zh: : 但我只知道一个那样的地方，而且——

lines.en: : Cool! Then you know where to go!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那你知道该去哪儿了！

lines.en: : Kirin-
lines.zh: : Kirin——

lines.en: : See you soon, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 一会儿见，老师！

lines.en: scene black
Kirin hangs up the phone before I have the chance to tell her that the only place I know of that fits that criteria is the restaurant Touka took me to during the first Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: Kirin 没等我说出口就挂了电话——我本想告诉她，我所知道的符合那个标准的地方，只有第一次宿舍战争时 Touka 带我去的那家餐厅。

lines.en: This is even more problematic because, if my memory serves me well, I couldn’t even pronounce anything on that menu.
lines.zh: 这更麻烦的是，如果我没记错的话，那菜单上的东西我连念都念不出来。

lines.en: But I guess it’s fine to be frivolous every now and then considering that saving up my money will do absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，偶尔挥霍一下大概也没关系，毕竟存钱对我来说一点用都没有。

lines.en: And hey, if it lets Kirin finally experience something she can lord over her sister or anyone else who tries to pick on her, fine.
lines.zh: 而且，如果这能让 Kirin 终于体验到一件可以拿来在她姐姐或任何想欺负她的人面前炫耀的事，那也值。

lines.en: She doesn’t have many things like that.
lines.zh: 她拥有的这种东西不多。

lines.en: And if she’s as attractive tonight as she’s making herself sound-
lines.zh: 而且，如果她今晚真像她说的那么好看——

lines.en: Actually, if she’s as attractive tonight as she’s making herself sound, I {i}don’t{/i} want other people to see her. But I guess it’s too late for that.
lines.zh: 其实，如果她今晚真像她说的那么好看，我{i}可不{/i}想让其他人看见她。不过现在说这个大概太迟了。

lines.en: After typing “Kumon-mi fancy restaurants” into a search engine, I manage to find the place and...swallow my tongue as I send Kirin the address.
lines.zh: 在搜索引擎里输入“Kumon-mi 高级餐厅”之后，我总算找到了那家店，然后……咬着牙把地址发给了 Kirin。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate1
We decide to meet around the corner from the restaurant as standing directly in front of a place as high-class as that would have been extremely weird for whichever one of us got there first.
lines.zh: 我们约在餐厅拐角处碰面，因为直接站在那种高级场所的正门口，对先到的那个人来说会非常奇怪。

lines.en: Which, judging by the fact that I am staring at a pair of vending machines instead of a girl, seems to be me.
lines.zh: 而从我现在盯着的是两台自动售货机、而不是一个女生来看，先到的人似乎是我。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate2
: Excuse me, sir...you wouldn’t happen to be my date, would you?
lines.zh: : 不好意思，先生……你该不会是我的约会对象吧？

lines.en: : No. I have no idea who you are.
lines.zh: : 不是。我不知道你是谁。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate3
: Hey. I’m not {i}that{/i} unrecognizable.
lines.zh: : 嘿。我还没{i}那么{/i}认不出来吧。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t happen to be Kirin’s mom, would you? You look really familiar.
lines.zh: : 你该不会是 Kirin 的妈妈吧？你看着真眼熟。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate4
: That’s me- here to cheat on my husband and open up the opportunity for you to fuck {i}all{/i} of the Kanda women one day.
lines.zh: : 正是在下——背着丈夫出来偷情，顺便给你将来睡遍{i}所有{/i}神田家女性打开大门。

lines.en: : You look like five years older than normal, Kirin. It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 你看起来比平时大了五岁，Kirin。挺怪的。

lines.en: : I clean up pretty good, right? I could probably pass for a college student right now, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 我打扮起来还挺像样的吧？我现在大概能装成个大学生，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Unfortunately, all I can think of right now is pushing you up against those vending machines and impregnating you.
lines.zh: : 不巧的是，我现在满脑子只想着把你按在那两台自动售货机上，让你怀上我的孩子。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate5
: It’s the skirt, right? It makes me look at least three times more breedable than normal.
lines.zh: : 是裙子的功劳吧？它让我看起来比平时好生养了至少三倍。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate6
: Maybe don’t impregnate me, though? I’d be a horrible mom and you’d be no better of a father.
lines.zh: : 不过也许别让我怀孕？我会是个糟糕的妈妈，而当爹的你也好不到哪儿去。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’d normally agree, but that skirt is doing things to me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我平时也会同意，但那条裙子正在对我做些奇怪的事。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate7
: I’ll keep that in mind for the future. Right now, we have reservations.
lines.zh: : 我以后会记住的。现在嘛，我们有预约。

lines.en: : I didn’t make reservations. I didn’t think we needed them.
lines.zh: : 我没预约。我以为不需要。

lines.en: : Yeah, I figured that’s what would happen. Which is why {i}I{/i} called and made reservations.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我就知道会这样。所以{i}我{/i}打电话预约了。

lines.en: : Oh, cool. That means you’re paying, right?
lines.zh: : 哦，不错。那意思是你请客，对吧？

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate8
: Not. A. Fucking. Chance.
lines.zh: : 想。都。别。想。

lines.en: scene black
Kirin (The suddenly older model) and I round the corner and head into the restaurant.
lines.zh: Kirin（突然升级版）和我转过拐角，走进了餐厅。

lines.en: The first time I came here, the entire venue was rented out for the sake of Touka flaunting her wealth or whatever. But this time, the place is pretty much packed.
lines.zh: 我第一次来这里的时候，整个场地都被 Touka 包下来炫富还是干什么的。但这一次，店里几乎坐满了。

lines.en: The only tables that remain vacant are ones with “Reserved” signs propped up on top of them.
lines.zh: 唯一还空着的桌子，是那些上面立着“已预订”牌子的。

lines.en: And while this amount of people would normally cause me to worry on account of my {i}date’s{/i} age...that doesn’t seem to be a problem tonight.
lines.zh: 虽然这么多人通常会让我替{i}约会对象{/i}的年纪担心……但今晚这似乎不成问题。

lines.en: Sure, Kirin is still significantly smaller than me, but her new look combined with the way she’s carrying herself makes her seem old enough to not be problematic, I guess.
lines.zh: 当然，Kirin 还是比我矮上不少，但她的全新造型加上她举手投足的方式，让她看起来年纪够大，应该不会惹麻烦，我猜。

lines.en: In fact, people probably think I’m rich as hell for bagging someone like her.
lines.zh: 事实上，别人大概会觉得我他妈的有钱，才能泡到她这样的。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate9
We’re sat down at a table near the piano, equipped with an accompanying lounge singer, and our orders are taken almost immediately after.
lines.zh: 我们被带到靠近钢琴的一桌，旁边还配了个驻唱歌手，落座后几乎立刻就有人来点单。

lines.en: Kirin also manages to order a glass of wine without the waitress thinking anything suspicious- which completely validates my thought just moments ago about this not being that weird.
lines.zh: Kirin 还成功点了一杯葡萄酒，服务生也没觉得可疑——这完全印证了我刚才的想法：这事儿没那么怪。

lines.en: Well...not {i}looking{/i} that weird.
lines.zh: 嗯……是{i}看起来{/i}没那么怪。

lines.en: It’s still pretty fucking weird when you think about it. But that’s exactly why I just try not to think about it.
lines.zh: 仔细想想还是他妈挺怪的。不过正因为如此，我才尽量不去想它。

lines.en: : Good pick, Sensei. How’d you find out about this place?
lines.zh: : 选得不错，老师。你是怎么知道这家店的？

lines.en: : I came here on a date with another girl.
lines.zh: : 我带另一个女生来这里约会过。

lines.en: : There you go again, always knowing exactly what to say to make me happy.
lines.zh: : 你又来了，总是清楚该说什么才能让我开心。

lines.en: : This is different than that, though. I don’t think either of us really felt comfortable on that first date.
lines.zh: : 不过这次不一样。我觉得我们两个在那第一次约会时都不太自在。

lines.en: : Are you saying you feel comfortable with me?
lines.zh: : 你是说你跟我在一起很自在？

lines.en: : Kind of, I guess? Which is pretty surprising considering there are other people here this time and the restaurant was empty during my maiden voyage.
lines.zh: : 大概吧？这还挺让人意外的，毕竟这次有别的人在，而我首航那会儿餐厅是空的。

lines.en: : Empty? Did you come with Ayane?
lines.zh: : 空的？你是跟 Ayane 来的？

lines.en: : Touka. Ayane and I don’t really do stuff like this.
lines.zh: : Touka。我和 Ayane 不太做这种事。

lines.en: : But you and {i}Touka{/i} do?
lines.zh: : 但你和{i}Touka{/i}做？

lines.en: : When there is a prize on the line, I guess so.
lines.zh: : 大概是有奖品的时候吧。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate10
: Ahh, Dorm Wars then. I’m still jealous I wasn’t picked for that this year. But I guess I {i}did{/i} manage to actually win my contest this time, so not {i}all{/i} was lost.
lines.zh: : 啊，那就是宿舍战争了。今年没被选上，我到现在还挺嫉妒的。不过我这次{i}确实{/i}赢下了自己的比赛，所以也不算{i}全{/i}输。

lines.en: : There’s always next year. Assuming the Date War isn’t banned for being too divisive, that is.
lines.zh: : 还有明年。前提是约会战争不会因为太撕裂人心而被禁掉。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate11
: To be honest, I’m surprised it wasn’t banned after the first time. Either way though, it’s not like I’d have a real chance at winning against...like, 75%% of the class.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我很意外它第一次之后没被禁。不过话说回来，反正我对上班里大概 75%% 的人也没什么胜算。

lines.en: : I refuse to believe I’d lose to, like...Yasu and Yumi. And maybe Nodoka and Molly. But I can see you choosing basically anyone other than those few over me.
lines.zh: : 我不信我会输给，那个……Yasu 和 Yumi。也许还有 Nodoka 和 Molly。但除此之外，我看你选谁都会优先于选我。

lines.en: : That’s because you have crippling self-esteem issues and dwell on the worst parts of everything ever said to you.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你有严重的自卑问题，而且总是对别人说过的每句话里最糟的部分耿耿于怀。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate12
: I mean, yeah. But also, there’s not really any “good” part of “You’re not enough for me” that I can latch onto to overcompensate for the bad part. Which was all of it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。但话说回来，“你对我来说不够”这句话里，也实在没什么“好”的部分能让我抓住，去抵消坏的部分。而它全是坏的。

lines.en: : Hey, either I can be honest with you or I can lead you on. Which one do you want?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我要么对你诚实，要么吊着你。你要哪个？

lines.en: : Honesty, obviously. I know you might think I’m upset about the whole “not enough” thing, but that’s really not it. I get it.
lines.zh: : 诚实，显然。你也许以为我在为“不够”那件事生气，但真不是。我懂的。

lines.en: : In fact, if you told me back then that I {i}was{/i} enough, it probably would have been creepy and made me feel weird about seeing you again. So I’m glad that’s not what happened.
lines.zh: : 事实上，要是你当时告诉我我{i}已经{/i}够了，那大概会很恶心，还会让我对再见你感到别扭。所以我很高兴你没那么说。

lines.en: : And yet, here we are out on a date because you want to {i}become{/i} “enough,” right?
lines.zh: : 可我们还是出来约会了，因为你想{i}变成{/i}“够”，对吧？

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate13
: No. We’re out on a date because I wanted to dress up and look hot and there isn’t anyone else who I think would appreciate that as much as you.
lines.zh: : 不是。我们出来约会，是因为我想打扮得漂漂亮亮、看起来很辣，而我觉得没有谁比你更懂得欣赏这一点。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate14
: But if you just so happen to start liking me more {i}during{/i} that date, that’s cool too. I won’t complain.
lines.zh: : 但如果你在{i}约会期间{/i}刚好开始更喜欢我了，那也不错。我不会抱怨。

lines.en: : And if that just so happens to continue blossoming into something more than just highly-compatible friends with benefits, I also won’t complain.
lines.zh: : 而如果那又刚好发展成比“高度合拍的炮友”更多的东西，我也不会抱怨。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate13
: You’re taking me dancing next time, though. What’s the point in looking all sexy if I don’t get to flaunt it?
lines.zh: : 不过下次你要带我去跳舞。我打扮得这么性感，要是不去显摆一下，那图什么？

lines.en: : Kirin, do {i}I{/i} look like I have ever danced at any point in my life to you?
lines.zh: : Kirin，{i}我{/i}看起来像是这辈子跳过舞的人吗？

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate15
: No. You look like a pathetic, mopey loser. But {i}I{/i} look hot and all of my attention will go to you. So, by extension, everyone will think {i}you’re{/i} cool as well. We both win.
lines.zh: : 不像。你看起来就是个可悲又阴郁的失败者。但我{i}很{/i}辣，而且我全部的注意力都会放在你身上。所以推而广之，大家也会觉得{i}你{/i}很酷。双赢。

lines.en: : And that’s {i}before{/i} the grinding happens. When that kicks in, we just win even harder.
lines.zh: : 而这还{i}早于{/i}贴身热舞开始之前。等那个一上场，我们就赢得更彻底了。

lines.en: : Lowkey, you could probably straight up fuck me in the middle of a dance club and no one would give a shit.
lines.zh: : 说真的，你可能就在舞池正中间直接干我，都没人会在意。

lines.en: : So it all comes back to sex once again.
lines.zh: : 所以又绕回性了。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate13
: It all comes back to-
lines.zh: : 又绕回——

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate16
: Wait, no. That’s not the point I wanted you to get from that.
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。我可不是想让你得出这个结论。

lines.en: : Yeah, sex is good. And pretty pivotal to the...overall foundation of our relationship, but the whole reason I’m starting to branch out like this is because I want stuff to, like...be more than that. I think.

lines.zh: : 比如……我想要在一个满是陌生人的房间里{i}干{/i}你的{i}选项{/i}。但我也想要那种，就……偶尔跟你一起吃饭的选项。

lines.zh: : 而且陌生人那件事甚至都不算，那个……纯粹的暴露癖欲望。我只是想那么做，因为那意味着人们会，那个……看见我们在一起。

lines.zh: : 哦。你想让他们看见我们{i}在一起{/i}。就像，作为一对真正的情侣。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate18
: Who just...have sex in public because that’s normal.

lines.zh: : 而我想让别人觉得我是被想要的……

lines.en: : If you want to be wanted, why are you always saying and doing things that you know will make people dislike you?
lines.zh: : 如果你想被想要，那你为什么总说、总做那些你明知道会让人讨厌你的事？

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate19
: I don’t know! I have no idea why I do half of the things I do when barely anything ever comes out the way I want!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！我都不知道我做的那些事有一半是为了什么，反正几乎没一件是按我想要的方式收场的！

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate20
: Maybe it’s...time for a change of strategy? Maybe it’s good to, like...you know, do stuff that {i}won’t{/i} directly hurt people every once in a while?
lines.zh: : 也许……是时候换个策略了？也许，那个……你知道的，偶尔做些{i}不会{/i}直接伤害别人的事，会比较好？

lines.en: : You don’t say...
lines.zh: : 你别说……

lines.en: : I’m not pretending I’m an angel when I know full well why no one likes me but you, Noriko, and Miku. And, you know, maybe I don’t need anyone other than you guys.
lines.zh: : 我可没装自己是天使，我清楚得很，除了你、Noriko 和 Miku，没人喜欢我。而且，也许我根本不需要你们以外的人。

lines.en: : I’m just tired of feeling so empty all of the time and sex didn’t work as well as I thought it would in filling me up.
lines.zh: : 我只是厌倦了每时每刻都觉得那么空虚，而性填补我的效果并没有我想的那么好。

lines.en: : You seem-
lines.zh: : 你看起来——

lines.en: : Here we are in what’s probably the nicest restaurant in all of Kumon-mi, completely incapable of relating to one another {i}without{/i} being perverted.
lines.zh: : 我们坐在这大概是整个 Kumon-mi 最豪华的餐厅里，却完全没办法{i}不{/i}靠下流来跟彼此产生共鸣。

lines.en: : Well, when a relationship is formed by a girl storming into your office, flashing you her underwear, and trading you her virginity for a handful of excused absences, it’s kind of hard to shake that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，当一段关系是由一个女生冲进你的办公室、对你亮出内裤，还用自己的初次换来几次请假特权开始的，那种底色就很难甩掉了。

lines.en: : The chances of that changing at this point basically don’t exist.
lines.zh: : 到这一步，它会改变的可能性基本等于零。

lines.en: scene kirinfancydate9
: What if they don’t have to? What if we can figure out a way to be ourselves {i}and{/i} become “enough” for one another?
lines.zh: : 如果不必改变呢？如果我们能找到一种办法，既做自己，{i}又{/i}成为彼此的“够”呢？

lines.en: : That’s exactly what you’ve been missing all along. You don’t {i}have{/i} to pretend to be someone you’re not just to get closer to other people. Because, more often than not, that only pushes everyone away.
lines.zh: : 那正是你一直缺失的东西。你{i}不必{/i}为了靠近别人就假装成另一个人。因为那样做，多半只会把所有人都推得更远。

lines.en: : Sensei...You do the same exact thing.
lines.zh: : 老师……你自己也在做一模一样的事。

lines.en: : I’m completely real with you, Kirin.

lines.zh: : 是啊，我知道。但你对 Noriko、Miku 和 Karin 就{i}不{/i}真实。我在她们面前看到的老师，跟我{i}一直{/i}看到的完全是两个人。

lines.en: : I just want to move forward in whatever fucked up way the two of {i}us{/i} can because watching you progress with all of them makes me realize that we haven’t gone {i}anywhere{/i} yet.

lines.en: : This was never meant to be anything more than a way for the two of us to benefit without any sort of emotional attachment. {i}That’s{/i} what we wanted.

lines.en: : And you know what? I enjoyed them. They really hit the spot for lunch today.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我还挺喜欢的。它们今天当午饭正合我意。

lines.zh: : 没有人{i}总能{/i}得到自己想要的东西。而那不是坏事。

lines.en: : Because sometimes, we don’t even really {i}know{/i} what we want until something else falls into our hands.
lines.zh: : 因为有时候，在别的东西落到我们手上之前，我们根本{i}不知道{/i}自己想要什么。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night

lines.zh: 因为今晚，我在床上躺下时收到了一份额外的礼物。

lines.en: But what I received instead is something entirely different.
lines.zh: 但我收到的东西，完全是另一回事。

lines.en: And it fills me with both a sense of extreme discomfort...and another feeling I have a hard time putting into words.
lines.zh: 它让我同时感到极度的不自在……还有一种我很难用言语形容的感觉。

lines.en: I tap on the new message notification-
